*   **Self-Intersection:** Tracing a ray from a vertex on the surface directly to the camera may immediately detect the surface itself as an occluder.

A distributed implementation of the Neubauer method optimized for large datasets using a cluster of render nodes.
It sets itself apart by scaling performance linearly with the number of nodes, addressing the scalability limitations of the single-node Neubauer approach.
It is chosen when rendering very large datasets (e.g., >400 MB) where single-node performance is insufficient.
*   **Time Complexity:** Asymptotically $O(n^2)$ for a volume of size $n^3$.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storage for the min/max octree.
*   **When to use:** When only sparse features (lines, loops) need visibility testing and full mesh extraction is too costly.
